purpose: Teach: といふ/劼/氣/ゎ/榮/佛/に当たりまして/翁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内文書の「といふ」、つまり「という」の旧表現を整理しろ
lines.en: Clean up the old-form 「といふ」—that is, 「という」—in our company documents.
lines.style: Crisp authority. Measured pace. Clear enunciation on each task. No room for misunderstanding. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の劼、つまり劼勉な姿勢を評価します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I will evaluate our employees' diligence and dedication in their approach to this.
lines.style: Respectful, methodical tone. Slight nod in the voice—affirmation before action. Precise, professional. Shows he's listening and taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社名に旧字「氣」、つまり気を残せ
lines.en: Keep the old character 「氣」—that is, 気—in our company name.
lines.style: Directive, calm. Deliberate pause before the old character to let its weight register. This is a choice, not a default. Slight emphasis on 「氣」.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品名の小書きのゎ、つまり「わ」のロゴを再検討します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll review the small 「ゎ」—the 「わ」—in our product logo and make any necessary adjustments.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Acknowledges the instruction without hesitation. Steady, professional. The sound of someone already taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業時の旧字「榮」、つまり栄を社印に残せ
lines.en: Preserve the old character 「榮」—that is, 栄—in our company seal from our founding.
lines.style: Measured, ceremonial undertone. Slight reverence for the founding legacy. Calm but weighted. The voice of someone connecting past to present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元寺の旧字「佛」、つまり仏教行事に協賛します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I will also sponsor the local temple's events and support their use of the old character 「佛」—仏.
lines.style: Agreeable, forward-thinking. Shows understanding that this extends beyond internal matters. Steady and present. A slight warmth—community matters too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業開始に当たりまして、社員に方針を示せ
lines.en: As we begin this new business venture, communicate our direction and philosophy to the staff.
lines.style: Formal, measured. A shift to something larger—vision, not just tasks. Slight weight on 「当たりまして」. Clear expectation that this will be done thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者翁、つまり翁様の遺訓を社員に伝えます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I will convey the founder's wisdom and teachings to our employees so they understand our legacy.
lines.style: Solemn, respectful closing. The voice deepens slightly—this is inheritance, not just instruction. Slow, careful. Honoring what came before.
